how: The index fell 33.5% from this close to the 4 December close.

t: Fed raises the discount rate to 6%
how: S&P 500 −1.1% to 316.70. The date is from a secondary summary and was not checked in a primary source.

t: Merger-tax bill and trade deficit: S&P 500 −3.0%
how: First of three heavy days; the index lost more than 9% over the week.
The fall left portfolio-insurance programmes with large amounts still to sell on Monday.
Portfolio insurers were about 40% of futures selling outside market makers. The volatility index closed at a record 150.2.

t: Fed: ready “to serve as a source of liquidity”
how: Statement before the open. Intraday low 216.46, never broken; close +5.3% to 236.83. Futures were halted for a time and companies announced buybacks.
Two-day gain of 14.9% from the Monday close. The rally failed within three sessions.
Held 1.3% above the crash-day close. The Nasdaq Composite made its closing low two sessions later.

t: Closing low: 223.92, 0.4% under the crash close
how: Volume was normal and the volatility index was 47.6 against 150 in October. The 20 October intraday low held.

t: Follow-through day, sixth session after the low
how: +2.9% to 242.19 on higher volume. The index was back above its 50-day average four sessions later.
